filter.description:
Legacy OPAL boolean expression string for the filter predicate (without the leading `filter` verb).

Deprecated in favor of `pipeline` and may be removed in a future API version. When creating or updating a filter, clients must provide exactly one of `filter` or `pipeline`.
API responses always include both `filter` and `pipeline`; clients should consume `pipeline`.

pipeline.description:
Canonical OPAL pipeline snippet for the filter. May contain only filter verbs (and comments).

When creating or updating a filter, clients must provide exactly one of `filter` or `pipeline`.
API responses always include both `filter` and `pipeline`; clients should consume `pipeline`.

disabled.description: Whether the filter is disabled by the user

errors.description: List of error messages if the filter has issues (omitted if no errors)

updatedBy.description: User who last updated the filter

updatedAt.description: When the filter was last updated

startTime.description: Activation window start time (inclusive). If omitted, the filter applies from negative infinity (unbounded from the past).

endTime.description: Activation window end time (exclusive). If omitted, the filter applies to positive infinity (unbounded to the future).

layout.description: UI layout/metadata for the filter builder. This field is used by the Observe UI and should be omitted by other clients.
